long_biography.plain_text:
Kathy Surace-Smith brought her life-sciences governance experience to Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, joining its board before serving as chair from 2020 to 2023. She now leads its major fundraising campaign, using business and civic networks to support cancer and infectious-disease research. Fred Hutch has also established two endowed research chairs funded by Surace-Smith and her husband, Brad Smith.

Her educational philanthropy reflects the international-law training they shared at Columbia. The couple endowed the law school's Human Rights Clinic, supported a scholarship for students from underrepresented countries and contributed to an international-affairs professorship. Surace-Smith is vice-chair of Columbia University's trustees and serves on advisory boards concerned with bioethics, justice and behavioural health.
